theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+0.94%) and Consumer Staples (+0.59%) led the market today, while Industrials (-2.66%) and Technology (-2.39%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.95%, defensives -0.25%, and value/cyclicals -0.92% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.88%, Dow -1.60%, Nasdaq -1.05% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.57%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 10.16% to 20.05, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 1.32% to $4,074.60, crude oil was little changed at $84.45, and bitcoin slipped 0.37% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
